C0427.title: Impact Analysis and Simulation of QR Code Phishing Attacks Using QRLJacker
C0427.summary: This study examines how cybercriminals hijack legitimate QR codes for login authentication, including the use of fraudulent QR codes on parking meters, and conducts attack simulations.

references.title: Impact Analysis and Attack Simulation on Quishing (QR Code Phishing) Using QRLJacker
